reason: Verified in the source and by driving the page. In render-b.js foot() is pushed inside the second .b-two child in owner-flight (line 179), owner-editing (line 212) and desk (line 166). Measured at 1440x960: .b-two and .b-bar both run 186-1254, .b-stick ends at y=650, but .b-foot runs 610-1254 with its top hairline at y=1475. So the page opens on a full-measure rule and closes on a rule that starts 424px right of it, leaving a 424 x 858 empty rectangle at the bottom-left under the largest object on the page. This is not taste: the design's own precedent contradicts it. print, phone and day already place .b-foot as a direct child of .b-field after .b-two and it spans the full measure there (print 380-1060 against .b-two 380-1060). Three states follow the rule, three break it. Neither automated gate measures column-edge alignment, and the seat's numbers are accurate. The fix is right in structure but wrong in two details, so it is sharpened rather than taken as written.
sharpenedFix: Edit render-b.js, not master.html - master.html is generated by build.mjs and hand-edits are lost on the next build. In render-b.js move foot() out of the second .b-two child and make it a sibling after the .b-two div, inside field(), in all three affected states: owner-flight (line ~179), owner-editing (line ~212) and desk (line ~166). That alone gives the footer the full 186-1254 measure and lands its hairline at the same y=1475 it occupies now, so nothing shifts vertically. Do NOT apply the proposed `.b-foot { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr }` - .b-foot is shared with phone, day and print, where it currently relies on flex-wrap plus justify-content: space-between. At 390 the footer already wraps to two lines in a 278px measure; three fixed columns would crush 'Updated 15 July 2026' (152px) and 'Signal Timeline' (114px), and in print the third cell is the 60-character share URL that depends on overflow-wrap: anywhere. Keep the existing flex rule unchanged - across the full measure space-between already sets the three spans on the left margin, near centre and flush right. Then re-run build.mjs and re-shoot approach-owner-flight, approach-owner-editing and approach-desk.
